text: Beep boop! Congratulations! You got admitted!

text: Welcome to the next chapter. I'm Sprout, and I want you to still know this stuff in four years.
caption: Welcome to the next chapter. I'm Sprout, and I want you to still know this stuff in four years.

text: Here's how first year usually goes. Lectures fly by. Notes pile up. Then it's eleven p.m., the test is tomorrow, and you have forty pages to read.
caption: Here's how first year usually goes. Lectures fly by. Notes pile up. Then it's eleven p.m., the test is tomorrow, and you have forty pages to read.

text: So you cram. You read it again and again until the words look familiar.
caption: So you cram. You read it again and again until the words look familiar.

text: Familiar is not the same as understood. The test comes, and you remember it. For a day.
caption: Familiar is not the same as understood. The test comes, and you remember it. For a day.

text: A week later it's gone. And then next semester builds on it. Nobody tells you that part.
caption: A week later it's gone. And then next semester builds on it. Nobody tells you that part.

text: Here's what I do instead. Drop in your notes, your slides, even a photo of the board. I turn them into lessons you can actually follow.
caption: Here's what I do instead. Drop in your notes, slides, or board photos. I turn them into lessons you can actually follow.

text: Stuck on a word? Tap it. I run over and pull the answer up in plain words, with an example.
caption: Stuck on a word? Tap it. I run over and pull the answer up in plain words, with an example.

text: Then I make you use it. Flashcards, quizzes, small challenges. Not copying. Explaining, choosing, building.
caption: Then I make you use it: flashcards, quizzes, small challenges. Explaining, choosing, building.

text: And I keep watch. A ten minute focus sprint when you can't settle. XP and a streak so you come back tomorrow, not just tonight.
caption: A 10-minute focus sprint when you can't settle. XP and streaks so you come back tomorrow.

text: Other tools give you the answer. I make you get it.
caption: Other tools give you the answer. I make you get it.

text: I notice what you find hard, so you spend your time there.
caption: I notice what you find hard, so you spend your time there.

text: Learn it once, properly, and the exams get easier too.
caption: Learn it once, properly, and the exams get easier too.
